summary: Two medium omissions: the accepted Habiro HB.2 Frobenius-selection request, and the source-backed Chebotarev/cyclotomic-Frobenius interfaces for KTheoryLowDegrees U.4 (whose packet remains partial and unreviewed). The fifteen retained links pass quotation, endpoint and production-graph checks. The map’s eight existing caveats are not counted again. Findings await independent verification.

findings.where: research/blueprint/links/tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_Chebotarev.json: links and examined[roadmapId=HabiroNumberFields]; Chebotarev Layer 10 -> HabiroNumberFields:HB.2
findings.claim: The complete map omits the accepted HabiroNumberFields blueprint request for Chebotarev in its Chern-class detection and local cyclic-dilogarithm comparison. Its examined entry says no search match, although the current packet explicitly names the supplier and two consumer nodes. Neither a sibling link nor an existing directed path covers the dependency.
findings.evidence: content/tau-ceti/Chebotarev/README.md:421-423 exports 'infinitude of every Frobenius class' and finite-exception invariance. content/campaign/HabiroNumberFields/README.md:24 asks "Establish CGZ's comparison with the finite Chern class under the precise good-n assumptions.". research/blueprint/packets/HabiroNumberFields.json is partial with an accepted independent review dated 2026-09-25. Its request names Chebotarev Layer 10 and neededBy HB.2/chebotarev-detection and HB.2/local-R-is-an-isomorphism; both complete node statements and proof steps were read. Calegari–Garoufalidis–Zagier, arXiv:1712.04887v3, Proposition 4.2 and proof, pp. 22–23, and Theorem 5.2 and proof, pp. 26–27 (https://arxiv.org/pdf/1712.04887v3, read 2026-09-30), use Frobenius selection in combined Kummer and cyclotomic extensions. The proof must establish compatibility before applying density. At atlas base 63dd274b65dec5cad2b579767df28ba8e75c8938, both endpoints exist and there is no forward or reverse path.
findings.fix: Add an evidence-backed Chebotarev Layer 10 -> HabiroNumberFields:HB.2 link and replace its negative examined entry. Cite the canonical stage text plus the accepted request and both node IDs in the reason. Require a finite Galois closure and a realizable conjugacy class, and remove finitely many bad primes. Retain the odd-prime-power/root-of-unity assumptions and the proof that the desired simultaneous restrictions extend to an automorphism. Kummer descent, local maps, scalar comparison and the finite-field isomorphism remain Habiro consumer work; density alone proves none of them. Do not add an effective bound or a new Chebotarev theorem.

findings.where: research/blueprint/links/tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_Chebotarev.json: links and examined[roadmapId=KTheoryLowDegrees]; Chebotarev Layers 10 and 4 -> KTheoryLowDegrees:U.4
findings.claim: The map omits the explicit number-field Chebotarev and cyclotomic-Frobenius inputs to the existing U.4 Bass–Milnor–Serre target. A current partial, unreviewed packet makes the two requests precise. Independent reading of BMS supports these particular inputs; this finding does not certify that packet or the full SK1 proof.
findings.evidence: content/campaign/KTheoryLowDegrees/README.md:83 says 'Use class-field-theory inputs with their actual statements where the argument requires them.' research/blueprint/packets/KTheoryLowDegrees--U.1.json requests Layer 10 for U.4/idelic-density-theorem and U.4/primes-with-norm-not-one, and Layer 4 for the latter. Layer 4's literal supplier phrase is 'the arithmetic Frobenius sends `ζ_m` to `ζ_m ^ 𝔑𝔭`'; Layer 10 supplies infinitude of each Frobenius class. Bass–Milnor–Serre, Publ. Math. IHÉS 33 (1967), Appendix (A.5)–(A.8), printed pp. 82–83, PDF pp. 25–26 (https://www.numdam.org/item/10.1007/BF02684586.pdf, read 2026-09-30): (A.7) combines Artin existence with abelian Frobenius infinitude; (A.8) chooses a nonidentity automorphism of k(ζ_m)/k when ζ_m is absent from k. No existing link or directed path joins either supplier to U.4 at the tested atlas base.
findings.fix: Record Chebotarev Layer 10 -> KTheoryLowDegrees:U.4 and Layer 4 -> U.4 with canonical endpoint quotations, BMS locators and the exact requested interfaces. Update examined. Explicitly retain the packet’s partial/unreviewed status; the source-backed interface is the claim, not acceptance of its surrounding blueprint. Limit the contract to number fields, m >= 2, absence of a primitive m-th root, and primes away from m. Preserve the separate class-field existence/ray-class dictionary needed for idelic density. Keep arithmetic Frobenius and absolute residue norm; do not replace them by an inverse or a rational-prime norm. Do not infer the function-field corollary or SK1 vanishing from density alone.
